CREATE VIEW [dbo].[bact_sample_all] AS
select a.*,sx.codena as pat_sexname, pt.codena as pat_typecodename,isnull(b.specimen_name,a.specimen_code) as specimen_name, isnull(c.purposename,a.purposeno) as purposename, isnull(cltpot.codena,a.collectionpoint) as collectionpointname, rm.req_comm, rm.reqsource, rm.sample_items, rm.physicycle 
from (
select sampleid,sampleno,labgroupid,hospcode,dbo.func_getdict('hospital',hospcode) as hospname,pat_hospcode,dbo.func_getdict('hospital',pat_hospcode) as pat_hospname,sampledate,teststatus,(case teststatus when '10' then '接种' when '20' then '培养' when '21' then '纯分' when '30' then '初鉴' when '35' then '上机' when '40' then '鉴定' when '50' then '药敏' when '60' then '报告发布'  else teststatus end ) as teststatusname,purposeno,specimen_code,emer_flag,specimen_comm,barcode,other_no,pat_cardno,inp_id,inp_date,pat_phone,pat_id,pat_no,pat_name,patname_py,pat_sex,pat_agestr,pat_ageyear,pat_birth,pat_typecode,pat_diag,pat_diag_icd,pat_height,weight,abo_bldtype,rh_bldtype,charge_typeno,req_deptno,dbo.func_getdict('DEPT',req_deptno) as req_deptname,req_wardno,dbo.func_getdict('ward',req_wardno) as req_wardname,req_bedno,req_docno,req_dt,sampled_dt,sampled_user,dbo.func_getdict('USER',sampled_user) as sampled_username,recieve_dt,input_dt,report_comm,charge_flag,alter_flag,req_reason,encrypt_flag,encrypt_user,dbo.func_getdict('USER',encrypt_user) as encrypt_username,stat_flag,germ_flag,pat_address,pat_nation,pat_idcardno,rechk_dt,rechk_user,dbo.func_getdict('USER',rechk_user) as rechk_username,reportid,report_user,dbo.func_getdict('USER',report_user) as report_username,lab_advice,smearflag,reserve1,reserve2,reserve3,reserve4,reserve5,prereport_dt,collectionpoint,linkid,recieve_user,dbo.func_getdict('USER',recieve_user) as recieve_username from bact_sample
union all 
select sampleid,sampleno,labgroupid,hospcode,dbo.func_getdict('hospital',hospcode) as hospname,pat_hospcode,dbo.func_getdict('hospital',pat_hospcode) as pat_hospname,sampledate,teststatus, '作废' as teststatusname,purposeno,specimen_code,emer_flag,specimen_comm,barcode,other_no,pat_cardno,inp_id,inp_date,pat_phone,pat_id,pat_no,pat_name,patname_py,pat_sex,pat_agestr,pat_ageyear,pat_birth,pat_typecode,pat_diag,pat_diag_icd,pat_height,weight,abo_bldtype,rh_bldtype,charge_typeno,req_deptno,dbo.func_getdict('DEPT',req_deptno) as req_deptname,req_wardno,dbo.func_getdict('ward',req_wardno) as req_wardname,req_bedno,req_docno,req_dt,sampled_dt,sampled_user,dbo.func_getdict('USER',sampled_user) as sampled_username,recieve_dt,input_dt,report_comm,charge_flag,alter_flag,req_reason,encrypt_flag,encrypt_user,dbo.func_getdict('USER',encrypt_user) as encrypt_username,stat_flag,germ_flag,pat_address,pat_nation,pat_idcardno,rechk_dt,rechk_user,dbo.func_getdict('USER',rechk_user) as rechk_username,reportid,report_user,dbo.func_getdict('USER',report_user) as report_username,lab_advice,smearflag,reserve1,reserve2,reserve3,reserve4,reserve5,prereport_dt,collectionpoint,linkid,recieve_user,dbo.func_getdict('USER',recieve_user) as recieve_username from bact_sample_history as bact_sample_all
) as a

	left outer join dc_specimen as b (nolock) on a.specimen_code = b.specimen_code
	left outer join bact_purpose as c (nolock) on a.purposeno = c.purposeno
	left outer join seccode sx on a.pat_sex = sx.codeno and sx.kindno = 'SX'
	left outer join seccode pt on a.pat_typecode = pt.codeno and pt.kindno = 'PT'
	left outer join seccode cltpot on a.collectionpoint = cltpot.codeno and cltpot.kindno = 'CollectionPoint'
	left outer join req_master_pat as rm on rm.barcode = a.barcode

CREATE view [dbo].[CDR_INSPECTION_REPORT] as
SELECT 
lr.pat_id +'|'+ lr.pat_no + '|' + lr.sampleno+'|'+lr.reportid+'|'+lr.barcode rowkey,
lr.pat_id PATIENT_ID,--患者id
lr.pat_no OUT_PATIENT_ID,--门诊患者标识	
lr.pat_id IN_PATIENT_ID,--住院患者标识	
lr.pat_no INP_NO,--住院号	上面三个号至少有一个不为空
''HEALTH_CARD_NO,--健康卡号	
''CASE_NO,--病案号	
lr.pat_no OUTP_NO,--门诊号	
rmp.inp_id VISIT_ID,--就诊流水号	确定唯一一次就诊
case when lr.pat_typecode = '1' then '01' 
 when lr.pat_typecode = '3' then '02' end VISIT_TYPE_CODE,--就诊类型编码	例：01或02  01：门诊，02：住院
case when lr.pat_typecode = '1' then '门诊' 
 when lr.pat_typecode = '3' then '住院' end VISIT_TYPE_NAME,--就诊类型名称	例：01或02  01：门诊，02：住院
lr.pat_name PERSON_NAME,--姓名	
lr.pat_sex SEX_CODE,--性别编码	
lr.pat_sex SEX_NAME,--性别名称	
lr.pat_birth DATE_OF_BIRTH,--出生日期	
lr.pat_ageyear AGE_UNIT,--年龄单位	
'岁'AGE_VALUE,--年龄值	
lr.pat_phone PHONE_NUMBER,--电话	
lr.req_deptno STAY_DEPT_CODE,--所在科室编码	
(SELECT deptname from dc_dept dd where dd.deptno=lr.req_deptno) STAY_DEPT_NAME,--所在科室名称	
lr.req_wardno STAY_DISTRICT_CODE,--所在病区编码	
(SELECT deptname from dc_dept dd where dd.deptno=lr.req_wardno) STAY_DISTRICT_NAME,--所在病区名称	
''STAY_WARD_CODE,--所在病房编码	
''STAY_WARD_NAME,--所在病房名称	
lr.req_bedno STAY_BED,--所在床号	
''ORDER_NO,--医嘱序号	对应HIS中的医嘱唯一标识/order_sn
''ORDER_ITEM_CODE,--医嘱项编码	对应HIS的医嘱项/医嘱编码
''ORDER_ITEM_NAME,--医嘱项名称	对应HIS的医嘱项/医嘱编码
''CHARGE_ITEM_CODE,--收费项编码	对应HIS中的收费码，如果没有可以为空
''CHARGE_ITEM_NAME,--收费项名称	对应HIS中的收费码，如果没有可以为空
rmp.Req_GroupID LAB_TYPE_CODE,--检验类别编码	检验大类：血液、生化、免疫、微生物等类型
rmp.req_groupna LAB_TYPE_NAME,--检验类别名称	检验大类：血液、生化、免疫、微生物等类型
stuff ( (select ','+m.Req_ItemCode from req_detail m(nolock) where m.barcode = rmp.barcode for xml path('')), 1,1,'') LAB_ITEM_CODE,--检验项目编码	大项，如血常规、尿常规等
stuff ( (select ','+m.Req_ItemName from req_detail m(nolock) where m.barcode = rmp.barcode for xml path('')), 1,1,'') LAB_ITEM_NAME,--检验项目名称	大项，如血常规、尿常规等
lr.sampleno TEST_NO,--检验序号	检验顺序号
rmp.ORIGINAL_REQNO APPLY_NO,--申请号	对应HIS中的申请单号
lr.reportid REPORT_NO,--报告号	报告单唯一号
lr.barcode SAMPLE_NO,--样本编号	样本的唯一标识，可以是容器编号或样本标识
lr.req_dt APPLY_TIME,--申请时间	申请单开立时间
lr.req_deptno APPLY_DEPT_CODE,--申请科室编码	
(SELECT deptname from dc_dept dd where dd.deptno=lr.req_deptno) APPLY_DEPT_NAME,--申请科室名称	
''LAB_DIAGNOSIS_CODE,--申请诊断编码	
lr.pat_diag LAB_DIAGNOSIS_NAME,--申请诊断名称	
''APPOINT_DOCTOR_CODE,--预约医师工号	
''APPOINT_DOCTOR_NAME,--预约医师姓名	
''SAMPLE_APPOINT_TIME,--采样预约时间	
''PLAN_SAMPLE_TIME,--拟采样时间	
''PLAN_SAMPLE_WINDOW,--拟采样窗口	
rm.sampled_user SAMPLE_NURSE_CODE,--采样人工号	工号和名称必须有一个不为空
(select username from SecSysUser ssu where ssu.userno=rm.sampled_user) SAMPLE_NURSE_NAME,--采样人姓名	工号和名称必须有一个不为空
lr.specimen_code SPECIMAN_TYPE_CODE,--样本类型编码	
lr.specimen_name SPECIMAN_TYPE_NAME,--样本类型名称	
''SAMPLING_POSITION_CODE,--采样部位编码	
''SAMPLING_POSITION_NAME,--采样部位名称	
''SAMPLE_METHOD_CODE,--采样方法编码	
''SAMPLE_METHOD_NAME,--采样方法名称	
''SAMPLE_VOLUME,--采样量	
''SAMPLE_WINDOW,--采样窗口	
rm.sampled_dt SAMPLE_TIME,--采样时间	
rm.send_user SPEC_SENDER_CODE,--送检人工号	
(select username from SecSysUser ssu where ssu.userno=rm.send_user) SPEC_SENDER_NAME,--送检人姓名	
rm.send_dt SPEC_SEND_TIME,--送检时间	样本送检时间
rm.recieve_user SPEC_CONFIRMER_CODE,--签收人（确认人）工号	
(select username from SecSysUser ssu where ssu.userno=rm.recieve_user) SPEC_CONFIRMER_NAME,--签收人（确认人）姓名	
rm.recieve_dt SPEC_CONFIRM_TIME,--签收确认时间	
rm.test_user PERFORMED_DOCTOR_CODE,--检验上机人员工号	
(select username from SecSysUser ssu where ssu.userno=rm.test_user) PERFORMED_DOCTOR_NAME,--检验上机人员姓名	
''LAB_DEVICE_SN,--检验设备代码	
''LAB_DEVICE_NAME,--检验设备名称	
''LAB_METHOD_CODE,--检验方法编码	
''LAB_METHOD_NAME,--检验方法名称	
rm.test_dt LAB_PERFORMED_TIME,--检验执行时间	
''LAB_PERFORMED_DEPT_CODE,--检验执行科室编码	
''LAB_PERFORMED_DEPT_NAME,--检验执行科室名称	
''LAB_PERFORMED_GROUP_CODE,--检验执行组编码	小组
''LAB_PERFORMED_GROUP_NAME,--检验执行组名称	小组
lr.report_user REPORT_DOCTOR_CODE,--报告医生工号	
(select username from SecSysUser ssu where ssu.userno=lr.report_user) REPORT_DOCTOR_NAME,--报告医生姓名	
lr.report_dt REPORT_TIME,--报告时间	
''LAB_IMAGE,--检验报告图像	检验图像
rm.rechk_user REPORT_CONFIRMER_CODE,--报告审核医生工号	
rm.rechk_username REPORT_CONFIRMER_NAME,--报告审核医生姓名	
lr.Rechk_DT REPORT_CONFIRM_TIME,--报告审核时间	
'完成' REPORT_STATUS,--报告状态	完成、作废等
rm.cancel_user REPORT_ABORT_OPERATOR_CODE,--作废人工号	
(select username from SecSysUser ssu where ssu.userno=rm.cancel_user) REPORT_ABORT_OPERATOR_NAME,--作废人姓名	
rm.cancel_dt REPORT_ABORT_DATETIME,--作废时间	
--'http://10.10.10.74:8083/Publics/His/ViewLisReportPdf/reportid='+lr.reportid+'/user=admin' lis_url,
'\\10.10.9.175\cifs3\LIS\'+left(lr.reportid,8)+'\'+lr.reportid+'.pdf' lis_url,
lr.alter_flag IS_CRITICAL--是否是危急值,危急值标识 0否 1是

from  lab_report lr

left join req_master rm 
on lr.barcode = rm.barcode
left join req_master_pat rmp 
on lr.barcode = rmp.barcode

where lr.rechkflag = '9' and isnull(lr.pat_no,'') <> '' and lr.rptunitid not in ('55','54','21') 
      and lr.barcode not like '4%' 
	  and lr.sampledate >'2023-08-17'
	  and lr.barcode  is not null

CREATE view [dbo].[CDR_INSPECTION_REPORT_DETALL] as
select 
lr.pat_id+'|'+ lr.sampleno+'|'+lr.reportid+'|'+lr.barcode+'|'+lrr.rpt_itemcode rowkey,
lr.pat_id PATIENT_ID,--患者id
''OUT_PATIENT_ID,--门诊患者标识	
lr.pat_id IN_PATIENT_ID,--住院患者标识	
lr.pat_no INP_NO,--住院号	上面三个号至少有一个不为空
''HEALTH_CARD_NO,--健康卡号	
lr.pat_id CASE_NO,--病案号	
''OUTP_NO,--门诊号	
rmp.inp_id VISIT_ID,--就诊流水号	确定唯一一次就诊
case when lr.pat_typecode = '1' then '01' 
 when lr.pat_typecode = '3' then '02' end VISIT_TYPE_CODE,--就诊类型编码	例：01或02  01：门诊，02：住院
case when lr.pat_typecode = '1' then '门诊' 
 when lr.pat_typecode = '3' then '住院' end VISIT_TYPE_NAME,--就诊类型名称	例：01或02  01：门诊，02：住院
lr.pat_name PERSON_NAME,--姓名	
''ORDER_NO,--医嘱序号	关联医嘱号
''ORDER_ITEM_CODE,--医嘱项编码	对应HIS的医嘱项/医嘱编码
''ORDER_ITEM_NAME,--医嘱项名称	对应HIS的医嘱项/医嘱编码
''CHARGE_ITEM_CODE,--收费项编码	对应HIS中的收费码，如果没有可以为空
''CHARGE_ITEM_NAME,--收费项名称	对应HIS中的收费码，如果没有可以为空
''LAB_ITEM_CODE,--检验项目编码	大项，如血常规、尿常规等，一般是LIS中自定义的检验项目
lr.req_reason LAB_ITEM_NAME,--检验项目名称	大项，如血常规、尿常规等，一般是LIS中自定义的检验项目
lr.sampleno TEST_NO,--检验序号	检验顺序号
rmp.ORIGINAL_REQNO APPLY_NO,--申请号	对应HIS中的申请单号
lr.reportid REPORT_NO,--报告号	报告单唯一号
lr.barcode SAMPLE_NO,--样本编号	样本的唯一标识，可以是容器编号或样本标识
lrr.rpt_itemcode LAB_SUB_ITEM_CODE,--检验细项编码	子项，如果红细胞、白细胞等
lrr.rpt_itemname LAB_SUB_ITEM_NAME,--检验细项名称	子项，如果红细胞、白细胞等
lrr.result_unit LAB_RESULT_UNIT,--检验定量结果单位	具体数值
lrr.result_str LAB_RESULT_VALUE,--检验定量结果值	具体数值
case 
when lrr.result_flag = 'P' then '阳性' 
when lrr.result_flag = 'Q' then '弱阳性' 
when lrr.result_flag = 'N' then '阴性'  else null end LAB_QUAL_RESULT,--检验定性结果	如：阴性、阳性，如果存在定量结果，可为空
lrr.result_flag RESULT_STATUS_CODE,--检验结果状态编码	结果描述，和参考范围比较的定性结果，偏高、偏低等
case when lrr.result_flag = 'H' then '偏高' 
when lrr.result_flag = 'L' then '偏低' 
when lrr.result_flag = 'P' then '阳性' 
when lrr.result_flag = 'Q' then '弱阳性' 
when lrr.result_flag = 'E' then '错误' 
when lrr.result_flag = 'N' then '阴性' end RESULT_STATUS_NAME,--检验结果状态名称	结果描述，和参考范围比较的定性结果，偏高、偏低等
''MICRO_ITEM,--微生物项目	只有药敏有，关联的微生物名称
lrr.result_unit MAX_RESULT_UNIT,--正常值上限单位	
lrr.Result_refh MAX_RESULT_VALUE,--正常值上限值	
lrr.result_unit MIN_RESULT_UNIT,--正常值下限单位	
lrr.Result_refl MIN_RESULT_VALUE,--正常值下限值	
lrr.result_ref RANGE,--参考范围	
lr.report_dt REPORT_TIME--报告时间
 
from  lab_report lr

left join req_master rm 
on lr.barcode = rm.barcode
left join req_master_pat rmp 
on lr.barcode = rmp.barcode

left join lab_result lrr 
on lr.reportid = lrr.reportid
where lr.rechkflag = '9' and isnull(lr.pat_no,'') <> ''
and lr.rptunitid not in ('55','54','21')
and lr.barcode not like '4%' 
and lr.barcode  >'1'  
and lr.sampledate >'2023-08-17'

CREATE view  CMT800 as
select 
BARCODE 申请号,
SampleNo 标本号,
PAT_ID 病历号,
PAT_NAME 姓名,
(case when PAT_TYPECODE='1' then '门诊'
	 when PAT_TYPECODE='2' then '急诊'
	 when PAT_TYPECODE='3' then '住院'
	 when PAT_TYPECODE='4' then '体检'
	 else '' end) 病人类型,
left(pat_AgeYear,charindex('.',pat_AgeYear)-1) 年龄,
PAT_DIAG 临床诊断,
REQ_DOCNO 送检医生,
REQ_DEPTNO 送检科室,
REQ_BEDNO 床号,
PAT_NO 住院号,
SampleDate 检查日期  from Lab_Report
where RptUnitID=109

CREATE view  EMR_INSPECTION 
as
select 
a.reportid as ID,-- 内码 VARCHAR2 100 是 主键
'YLV21051' as ORG_CODE,-- 医院组织机构代码 VARCHAR2 32 是 必填、按照平台机构填写
'山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,-- 医院名称 VARCHAR2 70 是 必填
(select  rptcomm5 from lab_rptunit where lab_rptunit.rptunitid =a.rptunitid) as LONIC_CLASS_CODE,-- 检验报告的分类的 LOINC 编码 VARCHAR2 64 CC99.00004- 是 检验报告的分类的 LOINC 编码
(select  rptcomm4 from lab_rptunit where lab_rptunit.rptunitid =a.rptunitid) as LOINC_CLASS_NAME,-- 检验报告的分类的LOINC 名称VARCHAR2 128 是 检验报告的分类的 LOINC 名称
(select  rptcomm5 from lab_rptunit where lab_rptunit.rptunitid =a.rptunitid) as LOCAL_CLASS_CODE,-- 检验报告的分类的本地编码VARCHAR2 64 是 必填
(select  rptcomm4 from lab_rptunit where lab_rptunit.rptunitid =a.rptunitid) as LOCAL_CLASS_NAME,-- 检验报告的分类的本地名称VARCHAR2 128 是 必填
'' as INSPECTION_TYPE,-- 检验类别 VARCHAR2 100
a.pat_name as NAME,-- 姓名 VARCHAR2 50 是 必填
'1' as OTHER_ID_TYPE,-- 其他身份证件标识 VARCHAR2 2 CV02.01.101
a.pat_idcardno as OTHER_ID_NUM,-- 其他身份证件号码 VARCHAR2 18
a.pat_idcardno as ID_NUM,-- 身份证件号码 VARCHAR2 18
case a.pat_typecode when  '1' then '1' when '2' then '1'  when  '3' then '2' when '4' then '3' end  as PATIENT_TYPE_CODE,-- 病人类型代码 CHAR 1 是 1：门诊 2：住院 3：健康体检
case a.pat_typecode when '1' then '门诊' when '2' then '门诊' when '3' then '住院' when '4' then '健康体检'end  as PATIENT_TYPE_NAME,-- 病人类型 VARCHAR2 50 是 必填
case a.pat_sex when  '1' then '1' when '2' then '2' else '9' end    as SEX_CODE,-- 性别代码 CHAR 1 0 未知，1 男，2女，9 不明是 0 未知，1 男，2 女，9 不明
case a.pat_sex when  '1' then '男' when '2' then '女' else '不明' end    as SEX_NAME,-- 性别 VARCHAR2 20 是 必填
a.pat_phone as TELEPHONE,-- 电话号码 VARCHAR2 50 电话号码
isnull(cast(cast(a.pat_ageyear as int) as varchar),0) as AGE,-- 年龄 NUMBER 0-200，不满一周岁，填 0
case when a.pat_ageyear<1 and a.pat_ageyear%1*12>1 then cast(a.pat_ageyear%1*12 as int) else '' end as AGE_MONTH,-- 年龄（月） NUMBER 0-11
case when a.pat_ageyear<1 and a.pat_ageyear%1*12<1 and charindex('天',a.pat_agestr)>0 then right(a.pat_agestr,charindex('天',a.pat_agestr)-1) else ''end  as AGE_DAY,-- 年龄（天） NUMBER 0-30
case when a.pat_ageyear<1 and a.pat_ageyear%1*12<1 and charindex('天',a.pat_agestr)=0 and charindex('时',a.pat_agestr)>0 then right(a.pat_agestr,charindex('时',a.pat_agestr)-1) else '' end  as AGE_HOUR,-- 年龄（小时） NUMBER 0-23
(case when a.pat_typecode in ('1','2','4') then a.pat_no
      when a.pat_typecode = '3' then a.pat_no + a.inp_id
            end) as VISITING_NUM,-- 就诊号 VARCHAR2 32 是 门诊或住院唯一标识号。或者健康体检表编号
a.req_bedno as SICKBED_NUM,-- 床号 VARCHAR2 20 床号
'' as CHARGE_TYPE_CODE,-- 收费类别代码 VARCHAR2 2
a.CHARGE_TYPENO as CHARGE_TYPE_NAME,-- 收费类别 VARCHAR2 50
a.sampleno as SAMPLE_NUM,-- 样本号 VARCHAR2 20
(select regcode from  dc_specimen where dc_specimen.specimen_code = a.specimen_code) as SAMPLE_TYPE_CODE,-- 标本类别代码 VARCHAR2 2 CC99.00006-检验标本类别是
case (select regcode from  dc_specimen where dc_specimen.specimen_code = a.specimen_code)
      when '11' then '血涂片' 
	  when '12' then '毛刷' 
	  when '13' then '胸腔积液' 
	  when '14' then '血液' 
	  when '15' then '胸水' 
	  when '16' then '腹水' 
	  when '17' then '针吸' 
	  when '18' then '网织红细胞' 
	  when '19' then '腹穿液' 
	  when '20' then '乳腺穿刺液' 
	  when '21' then '囊液' 
	  when '22' then '大便' 
	  when '23' then '尿液' 
	  when '24' then '分泌物' 
	  when '25' then '腹腔冲洗液'

'' as TEST_ITEM_CODE,--检验项目编码

case a.pat_typecode when '1' then '0' when '3' then '1' else a.pat_typecode end  as SYSTEM_FLAG,--系统标识  默认情况下：0-门诊 1-住院
a.barcode as REPORT_NO,--报告单编号
case a.pat_typecode when '3' then a.PAT_NO else '-'  end as INHOSP_INDEX_NO, --住院索引号
convert(varchar,a.Report_DT,120) as REPORT_DATE, --报告日期
'YLV21051' as CURR_MI_CODE, --当前医疗机构代码
'山东省第二人民医院' as CURR_MI_NAME, --当前医疗机构名称
a.pat_diag_icd as DIAGNOSIS_CLASS_CODE, --诊断类别代码
a.PAT_DIAG as DIAGNOSIS_CLASS_NAME, --诊断类别名称
case when a.req_bedno <'1' then '-' 
when a.req_bedno is null then '-' else a.req_bedno end as BED_NAME, --床位名称
a.req_deptno as DEPT_CODE, --科室代码
(select deptname from dc_dept(nolock) where deptno = a.req_deptno) as DEPT_NAME, --科室名称
isnull((select WardNo from dc_ward(nolock) where wardno = a.req_wardno),'-') as WARD_CODE, --病区代码
isnull((select wardname from dc_ward(nolock) where wardno = a.req_wardno),'-') as WARD_NAME, --病区名称
convert(varchar,a.sampled_dt,120) as SAMPLING_DATE,--采样日期
'1' as REPORT_STATUS,--检验报告状态
(select username from secuser(nolock) where userno = a.REQ_DOCNO) as SJRXM, --送检医生姓名
convert(varchar,a.REQ_DT,120) as START_TIME, --开始时间 
convert(varchar,a.Report_DT,120) as END_TIME , --结束时间 
'1' as IS_NORMAL, --有无异常 
d.ORIGINAL_REQNO as ELECTR_REQUISITION_NO,--电子申请单编号
(case when a.pat_typecode='3' then e.HIS_RefCol1 else a.barcode end)
as ORDER_NO,--医嘱号
convert(varchar,a.req_dt,120) as APPLY_DATE,--申请日期
a.req_deptno as APPLY_DEPT_CODE,--申请科室代码
(select deptname from dc_dept(nolock) where deptno = a.req_deptno) as APPLY_DEPT_NAME,--申请科室名称
a.req_docno as APPLY_DR_CODE,--申请医生工号
(select username from secuser(nolock) where userno = a.req_docno) as APPLY_DR_NAME,--申请医生姓名
convert(varchar,a.Recieve_dt,120) as EXECUT_DATE,--执行日期
'0502' as EXECUT_DEPT_CODE,--执行科室代码
'检验科' as EXECUT_DEPT_NAME,--执行科室名称
c.recieve_user as EXECUT_DR_CODE,--执行医生工号
(select username from secuser(nolock) where userno = c.recieve_user) as EXECUT_DR_NAME,--执行医生姓名
isnull(a.Specimen_CODE,'-') as SAMPLE_TYPE_CODE,--样本类型代码
isnull(a.specimen_name,'-') as SAMPLE_TYPE_NAME,--样本类型名称
a.sampleno as SAMPLE_NO,--样本编号
a.Report_User as REPORT_DR_CODE,--报告医生工号

isnull((select username from secuser(nolock) where userno = a.Report_User),a.Report_User) as REPORT_DR_NAME, --报告医生姓名
a.rechk_user as PROOF_DR_CODE,--审核医生工号
isnull((select username from secuser(nolock) where userno = a.rechk_user),a.rechk_user) as PROOF_DR_NAME,--审核医生姓名
d.Specimen_CODE as sample_code,

	inner join Req_Master_Pat d(nolock) on d.barcode = c.barcode

      and a.barcode not like '4%' 
	  and a.sampledate >'2023-08-17'

b.rpt_itemcode as OBSERVATION_CODE,--检验指标代码

'' as OBSERVATION_DESC, --检验指标描述
--(case when b.result_num is not null then convert(varchar(255),b.result_num) else convert(varchar(255),b.result_str) end) as TEST_RESULT_VALUE,--检验结果值
convert(varchar(255),b.result_str) as TEST_RESULT_VALUE,--检验结果值

case when b.result_num is not null then '数值型' else '阴阳型' end  as OBSERVATION_RESULT_TYPE, --检验结果类型
'' as BACTERIUM_ID, --细菌ID
(case when b.GermFlag='0' then '' else b.Result_Str  end) as BACTERIUM_VALUE, --细菌结果
case when b.GermFlag='0' then '' else b.rpt_itemcode  end  as BACTERIUM_TYPE_CODE, --菌种类型代码
case when b.GermFlag='0' then '' else b.rpt_itemname end as BACTERIUM_TYPE_NAME, --菌种类型名称
 '正常'  as IS_NORMAL,--有无异常
case a.pat_typecode when '1' then '0' when '3' then '1' else a.pat_typecode end  as OI_IND,--门诊住院标识  默认情况下：0-门诊 1-住院
case a.pat_typecode when '1' then '0' when '3' then '1' else a.pat_typecode end  as SYSTEM_FLAG--系统标识  默认情况下：0-门诊 1-住院
from lab_report a(nolock)
	inner join lab_result b(nolock) on a.reportid = b.reportid
	inner join lab_rptitem c(nolock) on b.rpt_itemcode = c.rpt_itemcode
	inner join lab_rptunit_item d(nolock) on a.rptunitid = d.rptunitid and b.rpt_itemcode = d.rpt_itemcode
 where a.rechkflag = '9' and isnull(a.pat_no,'') <> '' and a.rptunitid not in ('55','54','21')
 and (d.unprintflag not in ('1') or d.unprintflag is null)
 and a.barcode not like '4%' and a.barcode  >'1'  and a.sampledate >'2023-08-17'

when b.result_flag='Q' THEN '弱阳性'

(case when b.GermFlag='0' then '' else b.Result_Str  end) as BACTERIUM_VALUE, --细菌结果
case when b.GermFlag='0' then '' else b.rpt_itemcode  end  as BACTERIUM_TYPE_CODE, --菌种类型代码
case when b.GermFlag='0' then '' else b.rpt_itemname end as BACTERIUM_TYPE_NAME --菌种类型名称
from lab_report a(nolock)
	inner join lab_result b(nolock) on a.reportid = b.reportid
	inner join lab_rptitem c(nolock) on b.rpt_itemcode = c.rpt_itemcode
	inner join lab_rptunit_item d(nolock) on a.rptunitid = d.rptunitid and b.rpt_itemcode = d.rpt_itemcode
 where a.rechkflag = '9' and isnull(a.pat_no,'') <> '' and a.rptunitid not in ('55','54','21') 
  and (d.unprintflag not in ('1') or d.unprintflag is null)

  left join dc_hospital as phosp on a.pat_hospcode=phosp.hospcode 
  left join dc_hospital as rpthosp on dg.hospcode=rpthosp.hospcode 
  left join secsysuser inputuser on a.input_user=inputuser.userno 
  left join seccode nation on a.pat_nation = nation.codeno and nation.kindno = 'NATION'
  left join seccode pt on a.pat_typecode = pt.codeno and pt.kindno = 'PT'
  left join dc_specimen on a.specimen_code = dc_specimen.specimen_code
  left join secsysuser reporter on a.report_user = reporter.userno
  left join secsysuser rechker on a.rechk_user = rechker.userno
  left join dc_doctor docer on a.req_docno = docer.doctorno
  left outer join dc_dept d on a.req_deptno = d.deptno
  left outer join dc_ward w on a.req_wardno = w.wardno
  left outer join seccode sx on a.pat_sex = sx.codeno and sx.kindno = 'SX'
  left outer join lab_report_autochk as achk on achk.reportid = a.reportid
  left join lab_reportmark as rmk on a.markno = rmk.markno
  left join req_master_pat as mpat(nolock) on mpat.barcode = a.barcode 
  left join req_master as mreq(nolock) on mreq.barcode = a.barcode
  left join secsysuser smpuser on a.sampled_user=smpuser.userno
  left join secsysuser smpchkuser on mreq.sampled_chkuser = smpchkuser.userno
  left join secsysuser rceuser on mreq.recieve_user = rceuser.userno

			secuser ON secuser.userno = a.doc_req LEFT OUTER JOIN
			secuser userr ON userr.userno = a.doc_recv LEFT OUTER JOIN
			dc_dept ON dc_dept.deptno = b.pat_deptno LEFT OUTER JOIN
			dc_ward ON dc_ward.wardno = b.pat_wardno LEFT OUTER JOIN
			dc_hospital ON dc_hospital.hospcode = b.hospitalcode LEFT OUTER JOIN
			seccode AS SX ON SX.codeno = b.pat_sex AND SX.kindno = 'SX' LEFT OUTER JOIN
			seccode AS pt ON pt.codeno = b.pat_typecode AND pt.kindno = 'PT' LEFT OUTER JOIN
			seccode AS BCK ON BCK.codeno = b.chargekind AND BCK.kindno = 'BLDCK' LEFT OUTER JOIN
			nbd_dict_transproperties AS xz ON b.trans_properties = xz.codeno LEFT OUTER JOIN
			dc_chargetype AS fb ON fb.chargetypeno = b.charge_typeno LEFT OUTER JOIN
			nbd_sys_flows AS fl ON fl.code = b.ordertype and fl.hospcode=(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT hospcode FROM nbd_sys_flows WHERE hospcode =b.hospitalcode) THEN b.hospitalcode ELSE 'All' END)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN nbd_order_patinfo AS p WITH (nolock) ON b.pat_no = p.pat_no AND p.pat_name = b.pat_name
			left  outer join seccode  xxlx   on xxlx.codeno = b.blddonor  and xxlx.kindno ='BLDDONORTYPE'

	left outer join dc_chargetype c on p.charge_typeno = c.chargetypeno
	left outer join dc_specimen s on p.specimen_code = s.specimen_code
	left outer join secsysuser charge on m.charge_user = charge.userno
	left outer join seccode reqstat on m.req_stat = reqstat.codeno and reqstat.kindno = 'REQ_STAT'
	left outer join secsysuser cr on m.create_user = cr.userno
	left outer join secsysuser pr on m.print_user = pr.userno
	left outer join secsysuser sampled on m.sampled_user = sampled.userno
	left outer join secsysuser sampledchk on m.sampled_chkuser = sampledchk.userno
	left outer join secsysuser send on m.send_user = send.userno
	left outer join secsysuser recieve on m.recieve_user = recieve.userno
	left outer join secsysuser recieve1 on m.recieve1_user = recieve1.userno
	left outer join secsysuser test on m.test_user = test.userno
	left outer join secsysuser cancel on m.cancel_user = cancel.userno
	left outer join secsysuser reject on m.reject_user = reject.userno
	left outer join secsysuser report on m.report_user = report.userno
	left outer join secsysuser rechk on m.rechk_user = rechk.userno
	left outer join secsysuser discard on m.discard_user = discard.userno
	left outer join req_reject rj on rj.barcode = p.barcode
	left outer join secsysuser rjuser on rj.tellman = rjuser.userno

         a.report_dt as 报告时间,   
         a.report_user as 检验医生代码,   
         isnull((select username from secuser(nolock) where userno = a.report_user),a.report_user) as 检验医生姓名,   
         a.rechk_dt as 审核时间,   
         a.rechk_user as 审核医生代码,   
         isnull((select username from secuser(nolock) where userno = a.rechk_user),a.rechk_user) as 审核医生姓名,   
         a.report_comm as 报告单备注,   
         a.lab_advice as 实验室意见,   
         a.rechk2_dt as 二审时间,   
         a.rechk2_user as 二审医生代码,   
         (select username from secuser(nolock) where userno = a.rechk2_user) as 二审医生姓名,  
         a.prereport_dt as 预出报告时间,   
         a.lastprint_dt as 最后打印时间,   
         a.print_count as 打印次数,   
         a.release_dt as 发布时间,   
         --a.release_user as 发布人,    
         a.alter_flag as 危急值报告标志,   
         a.req_reason as 检验目的,   
         a.is_changed as 修改标志,   
         a.changed_afterreport as 报告后修改,   
         a.del_reason as 删除原因,   
         a.germ_flag as 细菌标志,   
         a.redo_flag as 复查标志,   
         a.upload_time as 上传时间,   
         a.test_info as 上机信息,   
         a.exprint_count as 外部打印次数,   
         a.instr_advice as 仪器诊断,   
         lab_result.rpt_itemcode as 报告项目代码,   
         lab_result.germflag as 细菌结果标志, 
	 lab_rptitem.rptcode as 报告项目打印代码,   
         lab_rptitem.rpt_itemname as 报告项目名称,   
         lab_result.result_str as 检验结果,   
         lab_result.result1 as 结果1,   
         lab_result.result2 as 结果2,   
         lab_result.result3 as 结果3,   
         lab_result.result_txt as 大文本结果,   
         lab_result.result_flag as 结果标志,   
         lab_result.alertflag as 危急值结果标志,   
         lab_result.result_unit as 结果单位,   
         lab_result.result_ref as 参考范围,
	 (select lab_rptunit_item.seq from lab_rptunit_item where lab_rptunit_item.rptunitid = a.rptunitid and lab_rptunit_item.Rpt_ItemCode = lab_result.Rpt_ItemCode) as 打印序号,    
         lab_result.instrid as 检测仪器ID,   
         Lab_RptUnit.rptunitname as 报告单元名称,   
         Lab_RptUnit.reporttype as 报告单元业务类别,   
         Lab_RptUnit.rptcomm1 as 报告单元备注1,   
         Lab_RptUnit.rptcomm2 as 报告单元备注2,   
         Lab_RptUnit.rptcomm3 as 报告单元备注3,   
         Lab_RptUnit.rptcomm4 as 报告单元备注4,   
         Lab_RptUnit.rptcomm5 as 报告单元备注5,

			inner join Lab_RptUnit (nolock) on a.rptunitid = Lab_RptUnit.rptunitid
			inner join lab_rptitem (nolock) on lab_result.Rpt_ItemCode = lab_rptitem.Rpt_ItemCode
			left outer join lab_rptunit_item on lab_rptunit_item.rptunitid = a.rptunitid and lab_rptunit_item.Rpt_ItemCode = lab_result.Rpt_ItemCode
	--inner join lab_rptunit b(nolock) on a.rptunitid = b.rptunitid
	--inner join req_master c(nolock) on a.barcode = c.barcode
where a.rechkflag = '9' and isnull(a.pat_no,'') <> '' 
and a.rptunitid not in ('55','54','21','100') 
      and a.barcode not like '4%' 
	  and a.sampledate >'2023-08-17'
	  and a.barcode  is not null

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[v_EMR_INSPECTION] AS
SELECT
    /* 1. 内码 */
    '49557032X' + '_' +
        ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(50), a.reportid), '') + '_' +
        ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(64), c.req_itemcode), '') + '_' +
        ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(20), c.seq), '') AS ID,

    '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE,
    '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME,

    cls_name.CLASS_CODE AS LONIC_CLASS_CODE,
    cls_name.CLASS_NAME AS LOINC_CLASS_NAME,
    CONVERT(varchar(64), d.rptunitid) AS LOCAL_CLASS_CODE,
    LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.ResultClass)), ''), cls_name.CLASS_NAME), 128) AS LOCAL_CLASS_NAME,
    LEFT(cls_name.CLASS_NAME, 100) AS INSPECTION_TYPE,

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(10)) AS REPORT_ERROR_TYPE,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(500)) AS REPORT_ERROR_REASON,

    LEFT(ISNULL(a.pat_name, ''), 50) AS NAME,

    /* 无明确其他证件时不重复填身份证 */
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(2)) AS OTHER_ID_TYPE,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(18)) AS OTHER_ID_NUM,
    LEFT(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_idcardno)), ''), '""'), 18) AS ID_NUM,

    /* D18 -- 病人类别 1＝门诊、2＝急诊，3＝住院，4＝体检；其他用户定义，来源于系统代码Kind=PT */
    CASE a.PAT_TYPECODE
        WHEN '1' THEN '10'
        WHEN '2' THEN '20'
        WHEN '3' THEN '50'
        WHEN '4' THEN '40'
        ELSE '10'
    END AS PATIENT_TYPE_CODE,

    CASE a.PAT_TYPECODE
        WHEN '1' THEN '门诊'
        WHEN '2' THEN '急诊'
        WHEN '3' THEN '住院'
        WHEN '4' THEN '体检'
        ELSE '门诊'
    END AS PATIENT_TYPE_NAME,

    CASE
        WHEN a.PAT_SEX IN ('1','2','9') THEN a.PAT_SEX
        WHEN a.PAT_SEX IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(a.PAT_SEX)) = '' THEN '0'
        ELSE '9'
    END AS SEX_CODE,

    CASE a.PAT_SEX
        WHEN '1' THEN '男'
        WHEN '2' THEN '女'
        WHEN '9' THEN '不明'
        ELSE '未知'
    END AS SEX_NAME,

    LEFT(ISNULL(a.pat_phone, ''), 50) AS TELEPHONE,

    CASE
        WHEN TRY_CONVERT(int, a.pat_ageyear) BETWEEN 0 AND 200 THEN TRY_CONVERT(int, a.pat_ageyear)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS AGE,
    CAST(NULL AS int) AS AGE_MONTH,
    CAST(NULL AS int) AS AGE_DAY,
    CAST(NULL AS int) AS AGE_HOUR,
LEFT(
    COALESCE(
        CASE
            WHEN a.PAT_TYPECODE IN ('1','2') THEN
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.custom1)), ''),
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_no)), '')
                )
                WHEN a.PAT_TYPECODE = '3'
                 AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_id)), '') IS NOT NULL
                 AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.inp_id)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
                a.pat_id + '|' + a.inp_id
            WHEN a.PAT_TYPECODE = '3'
                 AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_id)), '') IS NOT NULL
                 AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.custom1)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
                a.pat_id + '|' + RIGHT(a.custom1, 1)

            WHEN a.PAT_TYPECODE = '4' THEN
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.custom1)), ''),
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_no)), '')
                )
            ELSE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_no)), '')
        END,
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_no)), ''),
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.custom1)), ''),
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.barcode)), ''),
        REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(50), a.reportid), '-', '')
    ),
    32
) AS VISITING_NUM,

LEFT(
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.his_refcol2)), ''),
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.his_recordid)), ''),
        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.barcode)), ''),
        CONVERT(varchar(50), a.reportid)
    ),
    50
) AS ORDER_ID,
    LEFT(ISNULL(a.REQ_BEDNO, ''), 20) AS SICKBED_NUM,

    /* charge_typeno 样例多为“自费/居民医保/职工医保”，不应放代码字段 */
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(2)) AS CHARGE_TYPE_CODE,
    LEFT(ISNULL(a.charge_typeno, ''), 50) AS CHARGE_TYPE_NAME,

    LEFT(ISNULL(a.SampleNo, ''), 20) AS SAMPLE_NUM,
  ISNULL(smp.SAMPLE_TYPE_CODE, '99') AS SAMPLE_TYPE_CODE,
LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(smp.SAMPLE_TYPE_NAME, ''), '其他，请详述'), 50) AS SAMPLE_TYPE_NAME,

    LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.his_recordid)), ''), a.barcode), 20) AS APPLY_NUM,

    '49557032X' AS APPLY_HOSP_CODE,
    '山东省第二人民医院' AS APPLY_HOSP_NAME,

ISNULL(cs.APPLY_DEPT_CODE, 'A69') AS APPLY_DEPT_CODE,
       LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(dept.deptname)), ''), '待人工确认'), 60) AS APPLY_DEPT_NAME,

    TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.req_dt) AS APPLY_DATE,

    /* 标准说明为医生身份证号，但源表多数是工号；优先身份证，缺失时保留工号 */
    LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(doc.idcardno)), ''), a.REQ_DOCNO), 32) AS APPLY_DOCTOR_CODE,
    LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(doc.DoctorName)), ''), '体检'), 50) AS APPLY_DOCTOR_NAME,

    LEFT(ISNULL(a.pat_diag_icd, ''), 20) AS DISEASE_CODE,
    LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_diag)), ''), '健康查体'), 200) AS DISEASE_NAME,

    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.test_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.SampleDate),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.report_dt)
    ) AS INSPECT_DATE,

    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.sampled_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, b.sampled_dt)
    ) AS SAMPLE_TAKE_DATE,

    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.Recieve_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, b.recieve_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.report_dt)
    ) AS SAMPLE_RECEIVE_DATE,

    LEFT(ISNULL(lr.testmethod, ''), 500) AS EXAM_METHOD,
    LEFT(ISNULL(c.req_itemcode, ''), 20) AS EXAM_CODE,
    LEFT(ISNULL(c.req_itemname, ''), 36) AS EXAM_CODE_NAME,

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(100)) AS SPECIMEN_STATE,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(32)) AS SPECIMEN_PLACE_CODE,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(100)) AS SPECIMEN_PLACE_NAME,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(32)) AS SPECIMEN_RISK_CODE,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(100)) AS SPECIMEN_RISK_NAME,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(32)) AS SPECIMEN_QUANTITY_CODE,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(100)) AS SPECIMEN_QUANTITY_NAME,

    reject_map.SPECIMEN_REJECT_CODE AS SPECIMEN_REJECT_CODE,
    reject_map.SPECIMEN_REJECT_NAME AS SPECIMEN_REJECT_NAME,

    LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.input_user)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.report_user)), '')), 32) AS EXAM_ENGINEER_CODE,
    LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(input_user.username)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(report_user.username)), '')), 50) AS EXAM_ENGINEER_NAME,

    CASE
        WHEN a.report_user = 'admin' THEN '00942'
        ELSE LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.report_user)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.input_user)), '')), 32)
    END AS EXAM_DOCTOR_CODE,

    LEFT(
        CASE
            WHEN a.report_user = 'admin' THEN '尹慧'
            ELSE ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(report_user.username)), ''), ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(input_user.username)), ''), '尹慧'))
        END,
        50
    ) AS EXAM_DOCTOR_NAME,

    /* reportid 原值可能超过20，去横杠后多数可控制在20位内；仍建议跑下方唯一性核查 */
    LEFT(REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(50), a.reportid), '-', ''), 20) AS REPORT_NUM,

    'A30' AS EXAM_DEPT_CODE,
    '医学检验科' AS EXAM_DEPT_NAME,
    '49557032X' AS EXAM_HOSPITAL_CODE,
    '山东省第二人民医院' AS EXAM_HOSPITAL_NAME,

    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.report_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.rechk_dt)
    ) AS REPORT_DATE,

    CASE
        WHEN a.report_user = 'admin' THEN '00942'
        ELSE LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.report_user)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.input_user)), '')), 32)
    END AS REPORT_DOCTOR_CODE,

    LEFT(
        CASE
            WHEN a.report_user = 'admin' THEN '尹慧'
            ELSE ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(report_user.username)), ''), ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(input_user.username)), ''), '尹慧'))
        END,
        50
    ) AS REPORT_DOCTOR_NAME,

    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.rechk_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.report_dt)
    ) AS AUDIT_DATE,

    LEFT(
        ISNULL(
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.rechk_user)), ''),
            ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.report_user)), ''), '00942')
        ),
        32
    ) AS AUDIT_DOCTOR_CODE,

    LEFT(
        ISNULL(
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(rechk_user.username)), ''),
            ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(report_user.username)), ''), '尹慧')
        ),
        50
    ) AS AUDIT_DOCTOR_NAME,

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(64)) AS IMAGE_DEVICE,
    LEFT(ISNULL(a.report_comm, ''), 200) AS REMARK,
    LEFT(ISNULL(a.pat_diag_icd, ''), 20) AS DIAGNOSIS_TREAT_NO,

    CAST(NULL AS char(1)) AS CARD_TYPE,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(32)) AS CITIZEN_ID,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(32)) AS STATUS,

    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.Report_DT),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.report_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.rechk_dt)
    ) AS EFFECTIVE_TIME,

    CAST(NULL AS datetime) AS CREATED_AT,

    '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE,
    'INSERT' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(50)) AS DEI,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(50)) AS NODE_CODE,
    GETDATE() AS SYSTEM_TIME,

    /* 标本来源：1门诊，2急诊，3住院，4体检 */
    CASE a.pat_typecode
        WHEN '1' THEN '1'
        WHEN '2' THEN '2'
        WHEN '3' THEN '3'
        WHEN '4' THEN '4'
        ELSE '1'
    END AS SOURCE_CODE,

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(36)) AS CZRK_ID,

    LEFT(
        ISNULL(
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(input_user.idcardno)), ''),
            ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(report_user.idcardno)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(doc.idcardno)), ''))
        ),
        18
    ) AS DOCTOR_ID_NUM,

    LEFT(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(rechk_user.idcardno)), ''), 18) AS REVIEWERS_ID_NUM,

    TRY_CONVERT(date, a.LastPrint_DT) AS PRINT_TIME,
    CAST(NULL AS varchar(50)) AS PRINT_PERSON,

    LEFT(ISNULL(a.req_reason, ''), 100) AS LAB_PURPOSE,

    LEFT(ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.sampled_user)), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.sampled_user)), '')), 50) AS COLLECT_PERSON,
    LEFT(ISNULL(b.recieve_user, ''), 50) AS ACCEPT_PERSON

FROM lab_report a WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN req_master b WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON a.barcode = b.barcode
INNER JOIN req_detail c WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON c.barcode = a.barcode
   AND (
          c.reportid = a.reportid
          OR (
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), c.reportid))), '') IS NULL
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM lab_result m WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE m.reportid = a.reportid
                      AND m.req_itemcode = c.req_itemcode
                )
             )
       )
INNER JOIN lab_rptunit d WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON a.rptunitid = d.rptunitid
LEFT JOIN dc_dept dept WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON dept.deptno = a.req_deptno

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[v_EMR_INSPECTION_ALLERGY] AS
SELECT
    /* 子表内码：主表ID + 药敏项目关键字段生成稳定短ID */
    CAST(
        LEFT(
            '49557032X_ALLERGY_' +
            CONVERT(
                varchar(32),
                HASHBYTES(
                    'MD5',
                    ISNULL(ids.REPORT_ID, '') + '|' +
                    ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(64), b.rpt_itemcode), '') + '|' +
                    ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(64), c.seq), '') + '|' +
                    ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(64), c.medcode), '') + '|' +
                    ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(64), c.result_flag), '') + '|' +
                    ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(100), c.mic), '') + '|' +
                    ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(100), c.rad), '')
                ),
                2
            ),
            100
        ) AS varchar(100)
    ) AS ID, -- 内码 VARCHAR2(100) 是 主键

    CAST(ids.REPORT_ID AS varchar(100)) AS REPORT_ID, -- 检验报告单内码 VARCHAR2(100) 是 主表存在

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(e.his_recordid)), ''),
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.barcode)), ''),
                REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(50), a.reportid), '-', '')
            ),
            20
        ) AS varchar(20)
    ) AS APPLY_NUM, -- 电子申请单编号 VARCHAR2(20) 是

    CAST('49557032X' AS varchar(32)) AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构代码
    CAST('山东省第二人民医院' AS varchar(70)) AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(CONVERT(varchar(32), c.seq), ''),
                NULLIF(CONVERT(varchar(32), c.medcode), ''),
                '1'
            ),
            32
        ) AS varchar(32)
    ) AS ITEM_ID, -- 项目序号 VARCHAR2(32) 是

    /* 药敏结果代码：CC99.00093 */
    CAST(
        CASE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(32), c.result_flag))))
            WHEN 'R'   THEN '1'   -- 耐药
            WHEN 'S'   THEN '2'   -- 敏感
            WHEN 'I'   THEN '5'   -- 中介
            WHEN 'NS'  THEN '6'   -- 非敏感
            WHEN 'WT'  THEN '7'   -- 野生型
            WHEN 'NWT' THEN '8'   -- 非野生型
            WHEN 'SDD' THEN '10'  -- 剂量依赖性敏感
            WHEN 'N'   THEN '9'   -- 无判定标准
            WHEN '9'   THEN '9'   -- 无判定标准
            WHEN '+'   THEN '9'   -- 无判定标准，原始值保留到描述
            WHEN '-'   THEN '9'   -- 无判定标准，原始值保留到描述
            ELSE '9'
        END AS varchar(32)
    ) AS DRUG_ALLERGY_CODE, -- 药敏结果代码 VARCHAR2(32) CC99.00093 是

    /* 药敏结果名称 */
    CAST(
        CASE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(32), c.result_flag))))
            WHEN 'R'   THEN '耐药'
            WHEN 'S'   THEN '敏感'
            WHEN 'I'   THEN '中介'
            WHEN 'NS'  THEN '非敏感'
            WHEN 'WT'  THEN '野生型'
            WHEN 'NWT' THEN '非野生型'
            WHEN 'SDD' THEN '剂量依赖性敏感'
            WHEN 'N'   THEN '无判定标准'
            WHEN '9'   THEN '无判定标准'
            WHEN '+'   THEN '无判定标准'
            WHEN '-'   THEN '无判定标准'
            ELSE '无判定标准'
        END AS varchar(100)
    ) AS DRUG_ALLERGY_NAME, -- 药敏结果名称 VARCHAR2(100) 是

    /* 药敏结果描述：保留 LIS 原始结果，便于追溯 */
    CAST(
        LEFT(
            '原始药敏结果代码=' +
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(32), c.result_flag))), ''),
                '未知'
            ) +
            '；原始药敏结果名称=' +
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(100), c.medresult))), ''),
                '未知'
            ),
            1000
        ) AS varchar(1000)
    ) AS DRUG_ALLERGY_NOTE, -- 药敏结果描述 VARCHAR2(1000)

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(100)) AS PIECE_DRUG, -- 纸片含药量 VARCHAR2(100)

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(100), c.mic))), ''),
            100
        ) AS varchar(100)
    ) AS BACSTA_CONCEN, -- 最小抑菌浓度 MIC VARCHAR2(100)

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(100), c.rad))), ''),
            100
        ) AS varchar(100)
    ) AS BACSTA_DIAMETER, -- 抑菌圈直径 VARCHAR2(100)

    /*
      抗生素等级：原 SQL 固定为 1。
      当前未看到 lab_resultmed / lab_med 中有明确等级字段，暂保留原口径。
    */
    CAST('1' AS varchar(100)) AS ANTIBIOTIC_CLASS, -- 抗生素等级 VARCHAR2(100) 是

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(32), c.medcode))), ''),
            32
        ) AS varchar(32)
    ) AS ANTIBIOTIC_CODE, -- 抗生素代码 VARCHAR2(32)

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(100), d.medname))), ''),
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(100), c.medcode))), ''),
                '未知'
            ),
            100
        ) AS varchar(100)
    ) AS ANTIBIOTIC_NAME, -- 抗生素名称 VARCHAR2(100) 是

    CAST(a.rechk_dt AS datetime) AS EFFECTIVE_TIME, -- 活动发生时间 DATE

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(32)) AS STATUS, -- 卡片状态
    CAST(NULL AS datetime) AS CREATED_AT, -- 创建时间

    CAST('370104' AS varchar(6)) AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 所属行政区划
    CAST('INSERT' AS varchar(10)) AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型
    GETDATE() AS SYSTEM_TIME -- 数据上传时间戳

FROM lab_report a WITH (NOLOCK)

INNER JOIN req_master rm WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON a.barcode = rm.barcode

INNER JOIN req_detail e WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON e.barcode = a.barcode
   AND (
          e.reportid = a.reportid
          OR (
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), e.reportid))), '') IS NULL
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM lab_result m WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE m.reportid = a.reportid
                      AND m.req_itemcode = e.req_itemcode
                )
             )
       )

INNER JOIN lab_result b WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON b.reportid = a.reportid
   AND b.req_itemcode = e.req_itemcode

INNER JOIN lab_resultmed c WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON c.reportid = b.reportid
   AND c.rpt_itemcode = b.rpt_itemcode

LEFT JOIN lab_med d WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON d.medcode = c.medcode

CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT
        CAST(
            LEFT(
                '49557032X' + '_' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(50), a.reportid), '') + '_' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(64), e.req_itemcode), '') + '_' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(20), e.seq), ''),
                100
            ) AS varchar(100)
        ) AS REPORT_ID
) ids

WHERE a.rptunitid <> 50
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.barcode)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_name)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_sex)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.specimen_name)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND a.rechk_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND a.rechk_dt >= '20210101'
  AND a.rechk_dt <  '20250101'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lab_result m WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE m.reportid = a.reportid
        AND m.req_itemcode = e.req_itemcode
  )
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(32), c.medcode))), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND a.pat_name NOT LIKE '%测试%'

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[V_EMR_INSPECTION_IMAGE] AS
SELECT
    /* 子表内码：主表ID + 图片序号 */
CAST(
    LEFT(
        '49557032X_IMG_' +
        CONVERT(
            varchar(32),
            HASHBYTES(
                'MD5',
                ISNULL(ids.REPORT_ID, '') + '|' +
                ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(img.graphitemno)), '') + '|' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(20), img.seq), '0')
            ),
            2
        ),
        100
    ) AS varchar(100)
) AS ID,

    /* 检验报告单内码：必须与主表 v_EMR_INSPECTION.ID 一致 */
    CAST(ids.REPORT_ID AS varchar(100)) AS REPORT_ID,

    /* 电子申请单编号：与主表 APPLY_NUM 口径保持一致 */
    CAST(
        LEFT(
            ISNULL(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(rd.his_recordid)), ''),
                a.barcode
            ),
            20
        ) AS varchar(20)
    ) AS APPLY_NUM,

    CAST('49557032X' AS varchar(32)) AS ORG_CODE,
    CAST('山东省第二人民医院' AS varchar(70)) AS ORG_NAME,

    CAST(img.seq AS bigint) AS IMAGE_NUM,

    /*
      注意：
      Img_Lab_Graph.graph_image 是 image 二进制图片内容，不是路径。
      graph_data / extrainfo 当前样例为空，暂时无真实路径。
      这里先输出可追溯图片标识，保证字段类型为 varchar(80)。
    */
   CAST(
    LEFT(
        'LAB_GRAPH_' +
        CONVERT(
            varchar(32),
            HASHBYTES(
                'MD5',
                ISNULL(ids.REPORT_ID, '') + '|' +
                ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(img.graphitemno)), '') + '|' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(20), img.seq), '0')
            ),
            2
        ) +
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(img.fileext)), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN '.' + REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(img.fileext)), '.', ''), ' ', '')
            ELSE ''
        END,
        80
    ) AS varchar(80)
) AS IMAGE_SAVE_PATH,

    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.Report_DT),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.report_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.rechk_dt)
    ) AS EFFECTIVE_TIME,

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(32)) AS STATUS,
    CAST(NULL AS datetime) AS CREATED_AT,

    CAST('370104' AS varchar(6)) AS DISTRICT_CODE,
    CAST('INSERT' AS varchar(10)) AS EXCHANGE_TYPE,
    GETDATE() AS SYSTEM_TIME

FROM lab_report a WITH (NOLOCK)

INNER JOIN req_master rm WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON a.barcode = rm.barcode

INNER JOIN req_detail rd WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON rd.barcode = a.barcode
   AND (
          rd.reportid = a.reportid
          OR (
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), rd.reportid))), '') IS NULL
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM lab_result m WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE m.reportid = a.reportid
                      AND m.req_itemcode = rd.req_itemcode
                )
             )
       )

INNER JOIN Img_Lab_Graph img WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON img.reportid = a.reportid

CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT
        CAST(
            LEFT(
                '49557032X' + '_' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(50), a.reportid), '') + '_' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(64), rd.req_itemcode), '') + '_' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(20), rd.seq), ''),
                100
            ) AS varchar(100)
        ) AS REPORT_ID
) ids

WHERE a.rptunitid <> 50
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.barcode)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_name)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_sex)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.specimen_name)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND a.rechk_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND a.rechk_dt >= '20210101'
  AND a.rechk_dt <  '20250101'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lab_result m WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE m.reportid = a.reportid
        AND m.req_itemcode = rd.req_itemcode
  )
  AND img.graph_image IS NOT NULL
  AND DATALENGTH(CAST(img.graph_image AS varbinary(max))) > 0
  AND a.pat_name NOT LIKE '%测试%'

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[v_EMR_INSPECTION_ITEM] AS
SELECT
    /* 内码：主表REPORT_ID + 检验结果本地项目编码，生成稳定短ID */
    CAST(
        LEFT(
            '49557032X_ITEM_' +
            CONVERT(
                varchar(32),
                HASHBYTES(
                    'MD5',
                    ISNULL(ids.REPORT_ID, '') + '|' +
                    ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(64), b.rpt_itemcode), '') + '|' +
                    ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(100), b.result_str), '') + '|' +
                    ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(100), b.result_unit), '')
                ),
                2
            ),
            100
        ) AS varchar(100)
    ) AS ID, -- 内码 VARCHAR2(100) 是 主键

    CAST(ids.REPORT_ID AS varchar(100)) AS REPORT_ID, -- 检验报告单内码 VARCHAR2(100) 是 必填、关联报告单主表

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(rd.his_recordid)), ''),
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.barcode)), ''),
                REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(50), a.reportid), '-', '')
            ),
            20
        ) AS varchar(20)
    ) AS APPLY_NUM, -- 电子申请单编号 VARCHAR2(20) 是

    CAST(rd.seq AS numeric(18,0)) AS SN, -- 序号 NUMBER

    /* 检验项目代号：itemnote1 -> 对照表 -> 院内编码 */
    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(100), c.itemnote1))), ''),
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(imap.CS_ITEM_CODE)), ''),
                loc.LOCAL_ITEM_CODE,
                '9999'
            ),
            20
        ) AS varchar(20)
    ) AS ITEM_CODE, -- 检验项目代号 VARCHAR2(20) CS_EXAMINE_ITEM 是

    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.Recieve_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, rm.recieve_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.report_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.rechk_dt)
    ) AS RECIEVE_DT, -- 检验科接收时间 DATE

    /* 检验项目名称：itemnote2 -> 对照表 -> 院内名称 */
    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(200), c.itemnote2))), ''),
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(imap.CS_ITEM_NAME)), ''),
                loc.LOCAL_ITEM_NAME,
                '未知检验项目'
            ),
            80
        ) AS varchar(80)
    ) AS ITEM_NAME, -- 检验项目名称 VARCHAR2(80) 是

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN c.resulttype = '1' THEN '2'
            WHEN TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,4), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.result_str)), '')) IS NOT NULL THEN '2'
            ELSE '1'
        END AS varchar(32)
    ) AS RESULT_TYPE, -- 结果类型代码 VARCHAR2(32) 是 1文本 2数值

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN c.resulttype = '1' THEN '数值'
            WHEN TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,4), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.result_str)), '')) IS NOT NULL THEN '数值'
            ELSE '文本'
        END AS varchar(100)
    ) AS RESULT_TYPE_NOTE, -- 结果类型描述 VARCHAR2(100) 是

    CAST(
        LEFT(loc.ITEM_RESULT_SRC, 100) AS varchar(100)
    ) AS ITEM_RESULT, -- 检验项目结果 VARCHAR2(100) 是

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.result_unit)), ''),
                '-'
            ),
            20
        ) AS varchar(20)
    ) AS UNIT, -- 单位 VARCHAR2(20) 是

    CAST(
        ISNULL(
            TRY_CONVERT(decimal(12,2), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(40), b.Result_refl))), '')),
            0
        ) AS decimal(12,2)
    ) AS REFER_VALUE_LOWER, -- 正常参考值下限 NUMBER(12,2) 是

    CAST(
        ISNULL(
            TRY_CONVERT(decimal(12,2), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(40), b.Result_refh))), '')),
            0
        ) AS decimal(12,2)
    ) AS REFER_VALUE_UPPER, -- 正常参考值上限 NUMBER(12,2) 是

    CAST(NULL AS decimal(12,2)) AS CRITICAL_VALUE, -- 危急值 NUMBER(12,2)

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(20)) AS ALARM_STATE, -- 通知状态

    CAST(NULL AS datetime) AS CALL_DATE, -- 通知日期

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(100)) AS ATTACHED_RESULT, -- 附属结果

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.result_flag, '')))) IN ('H','HH','↑','HIGH') THEN '2'
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.result_flag, '')))) IN ('L','LL','↓','LOW') THEN '2'
            WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.result_flag, ''))), '') IS NULL THEN '1'
            ELSE '3'
        END AS varchar(32)
    ) AS RESULT_EXPLAIN, -- 结果值的解释 VARCHAR2(32) 是

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.result_flag, '')))) IN ('H','HH','↑','HIGH') THEN '偏高'
                WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.result_flag, '')))) IN ('L','LL','↓','LOW') THEN '偏低'
                WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.result_flag, ''))), '') IS NULL THEN '正常'
                ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.result_flag, '')))
            END,
            200
        ) AS varchar(200)
    ) AS RESULT_EXPLAIN_NOTE, -- 结果值的解释描述 VARCHAR2(200) 是

    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.Report_DT),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.report_dt),
        TRY_CONVERT(datetime, a.rechk_dt)
    ) AS EFFECTIVE_TIME, -- 活动发生时间 DATE

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(32)) AS STATUS, -- 卡片状态

    CAST(NULL AS datetime) AS CREATED_AT, -- 创建时间

    CAST('370104' AS varchar(6)) AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 所属行政区划

    CAST('INSERT' AS varchar(10)) AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型

    CAST(
        LEFT(loc.LOCAL_ITEM_CODE, 20) AS varchar(20)
    ) AS LOCAL_ITEM_CODE, -- 检验报告项目本地编码 VARCHAR2(20) 是

    CAST(
        LEFT(loc.LOCAL_ITEM_NAME, 80) AS varchar(80)
    ) AS LOCAL_ITEM_NAME, -- 检验报告项目本地名称 VARCHAR2(80) 是

    GETDATE() AS SYSTEM_TIME, -- 数据上传时间戳

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.result_flag, ''))), ''),
            1
        ) AS char(1)
    ) AS RESULT_CODE, -- 检验结果代码 CHAR(1)

    CAST(
        TRY_CONVERT(decimal(14,4), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.result_str)), ''))
        AS decimal(14,4)
    ) AS RATION_RESULT, -- 检验定量结果 NUMBER(14,4)

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.result_unit)), ''), '-'),
            20
        ) AS varchar(20)
    ) AS RATION_RESULT_UOM, -- 检验定量结果计量单位 VARCHAR2(20)

    CAST(rd.seq AS numeric(4,0)) AS TEST_SN, -- 检验项目顺序号 NUMBER(4)

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN c.resulttype = '1' THEN 2
            WHEN TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,4), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.result_str)), '')) IS NOT NULL THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS numeric(1,0)
    ) AS TEST_RESULT_TYPE, -- 检验结果类型 NUMBER(1)

    CAST(
        LEFT(loc.ITEM_RESULT_SRC, 50) AS varchar(50)
    ) AS TEST_RESULT, -- 检验结果 VARCHAR2(50)

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.result_unit)), ''), '-'),
            50
        ) AS varchar(50)
    ) AS TEST_RESULT_UNIT, -- 检验结果计量单位 VARCHAR2(50)

    CAST('49557032X' AS varchar(32)) AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构代码

    CAST('山东省第二人民医院' AS varchar(70)) AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(32), b.instrid), ''),
            32
        ) AS varchar(32)
    ) AS test_exam_equip_code, -- 检查设备编码

    CAST(
        LEFT(ISNULL(a.barcode, ''), 50) AS varchar(50)
    ) AS BARCODE_NO, -- 标本条形码号

    CAST(
        LEFT(ISNULL(a.pat_name, ''), 50) AS varchar(50)
    ) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN a.PAT_SEX IN ('1','2','9') THEN a.PAT_SEX
            WHEN a.PAT_SEX IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(a.PAT_SEX)) = '' THEN '0'
            ELSE '9'
        END AS char(1)
    ) AS SEX_CODE, -- 患者性别代码

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            ISNULL(
                NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_idcardno)), ''), '""'),
                '000000000000000000'
            ),
            18
        ) AS varchar(18)
    ) AS ID_NUM, -- 患者身份证件号码

    CAST('0' AS varchar(100)) AS MTU_REC_MARK, -- 是否互认标识

    CAST(NULL AS varchar(100)) AS MTU_REC_LIMIT_MARK, -- 互认范围标识

    CAST(
        LEFT(loc.LOCAL_ITEM_NAME, 100) AS varchar(100)
    ) AS HOSPITEM_NAME, -- 院内项目名称

    CAST(
        LEFT(loc.LOCAL_ITEM_CODE, 100) AS varchar(100)
    ) AS HOSPITEM_CODE, -- 院内项目编码

    /*
      国家平台项目编码：优先 itemnote1，其次对照表。
      注意：这里不再用院内编码兜底，避免把院内编码误当国家平台编码。
    */
    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(100), c.itemnote1))), ''),
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(imap.CS_ITEM_CODE)), '')
            ),
            100
        ) AS varchar(100)
    ) AS PROJECT_CODE, -- 国家平台项目编码

    /*
      国家平台项目名称：优先 itemnote2，其次对照表。
      注意：这里不再用院内名称兜底，避免把院内名称误当国家平台名称。
    */
    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(200), c.itemnote2))), ''),
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(imap.CS_ITEM_NAME)), '')
            ),
            100
        ) AS varchar(100)
    ) AS PROJECT_NAME, -- 国家平台项目名称

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.result_flag, '')))) IN ('H','HH','L','LL','↑','↓','HIGH','LOW') THEN '2'
            WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(b.result_flag, ''))), '') IS NULL THEN '1'
            ELSE '3'
        END AS varchar(100)
    ) AS ITEM_SIGN, -- 结果标识 1正常 2异常 3不确定

    CAST(
        LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN a.PAT_TYPECODE IN ('1','2') THEN
                        COALESCE(
                            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.custom1)), ''),
                            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_no)), '')
                        )
                    WHEN a.PAT_TYPECODE = '3'
                         AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_id)), '') IS NOT NULL
                         AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.inp_id)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
                        a.pat_id + '|' + a.inp_id
                    WHEN a.PAT_TYPECODE = '3'
                         AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_id)), '') IS NOT NULL
                         AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.custom1)), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
                        a.pat_id + '|' + RIGHT(a.custom1, 1)
                    WHEN a.PAT_TYPECODE = '4' THEN
                        COALESCE(
                            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.custom1)), ''),
                            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_no)), '')
                        )
                    ELSE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_no)), '')
                END,
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_no)), ''),
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.custom1)), ''),
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.barcode)), ''),
                REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(50), a.reportid), '-', '')
            ),
            32
        ) AS varchar(32)
    ) AS VISITING_NUM -- 就诊号

FROM lab_report a WITH (NOLOCK)

INNER JOIN req_master rm WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON a.barcode = rm.barcode

INNER JOIN req_detail rd WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON rd.barcode = a.barcode
   AND (
          rd.reportid = a.reportid
          OR (
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), rd.reportid))), '') IS NULL
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM lab_result m WITH (NOLOCK)
                    WHERE m.reportid = a.reportid
                      AND m.req_itemcode = rd.req_itemcode
                )
             )
       )

INNER JOIN lab_result b WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON b.reportid = a.reportid
   AND b.req_itemcode = rd.req_itemcode

LEFT JOIN lab_rptitem c WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON b.rpt_itemcode = c.rpt_itemcode

/* 统一整理院内项目编码、院内项目名称、项目结果，避免后面重复写表达式 */
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT
        CAST(
            LEFT(
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.rpt_itemcode)), ''),
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.rpt_itemcode)), ''),
                    '9999'
                ),
                100
            ) AS varchar(100)
        ) AS LOCAL_ITEM_CODE,

        CAST(
            LEFT(
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.rpt_itemname)), ''),
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.rpt_itemname)), ''),
                    '未知检验项目'
                ),
                200
            ) AS varchar(200)
        ) AS LOCAL_ITEM_NAME,

        CAST(
            LEFT(
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        LTRIM(RTRIM(
                            CASE
                                WHEN a.rptunitid IN ('14','43','19') THEN b.rpt_itemname
                                ELSE b.result_str
                            END
                        )),
                        ''
                    ),
                    '-'
                ),
                200
            ) AS varchar(200)
        ) AS ITEM_RESULT_SRC
) loc

/* 第二优先级：本地项目对照表，只取已确认映射 */
LEFT JOIN dbo.LIS_CS_EXAMINE_ITEM_MAP imap WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON imap.LOCAL_ITEM_CODE = loc.LOCAL_ITEM_CODE
   AND imap.LOCAL_ITEM_NAME = loc.LOCAL_ITEM_NAME
   AND imap.MAP_STATUS = 'MAPPED'
   AND imap.IS_CONFIRMED = 1

CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT
        CAST(
            LEFT(
                '49557032X' + '_' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(50), a.reportid), '') + '_' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(64), rd.req_itemcode), '') + '_' +
                ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(20), rd.seq), ''),
                100
            ) AS varchar(100)
        ) AS REPORT_ID
) ids

WHERE a.rptunitid <> 50
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.barcode)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_name)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.pat_sex)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.specimen_name)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND a.rechk_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND a.rechk_dt >= '20210101'
  AND a.rechk_dt <  '20250101'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lab_result m WITH (NOLOCK)
      WHERE m.reportid = a.reportid
        AND m.req_itemcode = rd.req_itemcode
  )
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(loc.ITEM_RESULT_SRC)), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND a.pat_name NOT LIKE '%测试%'

(case when (CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) - CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) - 8) >= 0 
	  then (CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) - CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) - 8)
	  else len(Cavalue) end )) as [签名证书]
,SUBSTRING(CAvalue,
		   (case when CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAValue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) > 0 
				 then CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAValue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) + 8 else len(CAvalue) + 1 end),
		   (case when CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAValue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) + 8) - CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) - 8 >= 0 
			     then (CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAValue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) + 8) - CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) - 8)
				 else len(Cavalue) end )) as [签名值]
,SUBSTRING(CAvalue,
		   (case when CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAValue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) + 8) > 0 
				 then CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAValue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) + 8) + 8 else len(CAvalue) + 1 end),
		   (case when CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI1]', CAValue ,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAValue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) + 8) + 9) - CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAValue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) + 8) - 8 >= 0 
			     then (CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI1]', CAValue ,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAValue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) + 8) + 9) - CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAValue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue) + 8) + 8) - 8)
				 else len(Cavalue) end )) as [时间戳]
,SUBSTRING(CAvalue,(case when CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI2]',CAvalue) > 0 then CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI2]',CAvalue) + 9 else len(CAvalue) + 1 end),
(case when (CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI2]',CAvalue) + 9) - CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI2]',CAvalue) - 9) >= 0 
	  then (CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI]',CAvalue,CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI2]',CAvalue) + 9) - CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI2]',CAvalue) - 9)
	  else len(Cavalue) end )) as [原文]
,CAvalue
, SUBSTRING(CAvalue,(case when CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI1]',CAvalue) > 0 then CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI1]',CAvalue) + 9 else len(CAvalue) + 1 end),
(case when (CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI2]',CAvalue) - CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI1]',CAvalue) - 9) >= 0 
	  then (CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI2]',CAvalue) - CHARINDEX('[RUIMEI1]',CAvalue) - 9)
	  else len(Cavalue) end )) as [serial]
from
--(select 'signid[RUIMEI]证书[RUIMEI]签名值[RUIMEI]时间戳[RUIMEI1]SSSS[RUIMEI2]原文[RUIMEI]100186[RUIMEI]20231114-32-99999[RUIMEI]100186' as CAvalue from dbo.Img_Lab_ReportBlob where infokind = 'RM_CA' ) as b) tb
(select REPORTID, ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX), CONVERT(VARBINARY(MAX), infocontent)),'') as CAvalue from dbo.Img_Lab_ReportBlob where infokind = 'RM_CA'
and last_dt>'2025-01-20 12:00:11.903'
--and reportid='20250120-1-501'
) as b) tb

CREATE   view [dbo].[vw_exportdiangroup] as
SELECT   TOP (1000) 
                a.barcode AS LISBARCODE, 
                b.pat_no AS CLINICID,
				b.pat_name AS PATIENTNAME, 
                (CASE b.pat_sex WHEN '1' THEN '男' WHEN '2' THEN '女' ELSE b.pat_sex END) AS SEX, 
				b.pat_agestr AS AGE, 
				(case b.pat_typecode when '1' then '门诊' when '2' then '急诊' when '3' then '住院' when '4' then '体检' else b.pat_typecode end) AS PATIENTCATEGORY,
				b.specimen_name AS SAMPLETYPE, 
				b.req_bedno AS BEDNO, 
                CONVERT(varchar(20), a.recieve_dt, 120) AS collectddate,
                (select doctorname from dc_doctor where dc_doctor.doctorno =b.req_docno ) AS DOCTOR,
                (select deptname from dc_dept where dc_dept.deptno =b.req_deptno ) AS SERVGRP, 
				b.pat_diag AS DIAGNOSIS, 
				c.req_itemcode AS TESTCODE, 
                c.req_itemname AS SINONYM, 
                CONVERT(varchar(20), a.sampled_dt, 120) AS samplingtime, 
				CONVERT(varchar(20), d.input_dt, 120) AS CREATEDATE, 
                CONVERT(varchar(20), d.sampledate, 120) AS collectiondate, 
                d.sampleno AS SAMPLENUMBER,
                '' AS QUANTITY, 
				b.req_comm AS SAMPLEPOINTS, 
                '' as  BARCODE
FROM       req_master  a ,req_master_pat b,req_detail c ,lab_report d
          
where    a.barcode=b.barcode and b.barcode =c.barcode and c.barcode =d.barcode 
         and substring(CONVERT(varchar(100), d.sampledate, 112),1,8)>CONVERT(varchar(100), GETDATE()-7, 112)
		 and d.rptunitid = '54'
		 and left(a.barcode,2)<> '01'
         --ORDER BY CREATEDATE,Convert(int,d.sampleno)

union
SELECT   TOP (1000) 
                a.barcode AS LISBARCODE, 
                b.pat_no AS CLINICID,
				b.pat_name AS PATIENTNAME, 
                (CASE b.pat_sex WHEN '1' THEN '男' WHEN '2' THEN '女' ELSE b.pat_sex END) AS SEX, 
				b.pat_agestr AS AGE, 
				(case b.pat_typecode when '1' then '门诊' when '2' then '急诊' when '3' then '住院' when '4' then '体检' else b.pat_typecode end) AS PATIENTCATEGORY,
				b.specimen_name AS SAMPLETYPE, 
				b.req_bedno AS BEDNO, 
                CONVERT(varchar(20), a.recieve_dt, 120) AS collectddate,
                (select doctorname from dc_doctor where dc_doctor.doctorno =b.req_docno ) AS DOCTOR,
                (select deptname from dc_dept where dc_dept.deptno =b.req_deptno ) AS SERVGRP, 
				b.pat_diag AS DIAGNOSIS, 
				c.req_itemcode AS TESTCODE, 
                c.req_itemname AS SINONYM, 
                CONVERT(varchar(20), a.sampled_dt, 120) AS samplingtime, 
				CONVERT(varchar(20), d.input_dt, 120) AS CREATEDATE, 
                CONVERT(varchar(20), d.sampledate, 120) AS collectiondate, 
                d.sampleno AS SAMPLENUMBER,
                '' AS QUANTITY, 
				b.req_comm AS SAMPLEPOINTS, 
                e.mixbarcode as  BARCODE
FROM       req_master  a ,req_master_pat b,req_detail c ,lab_report d,req_mixsmpdetail e
          
where    a.barcode=b.barcode and b.barcode =c.barcode and e.mixbarcode =d.barcode 
          and a.barcode =e.barcode 
         and substring(CONVERT(varchar(100), d.sampledate, 112),1,8)>CONVERT(varchar(100), GETDATE()-7, 112)
		 and d.rptunitid = '54'

isnull(a.report_user,'00942') as REPORT_DOCTOR_CODE,	--	报告医生代码
isnull((select username from secsysuser(nolock) where userno = a.report_user),'尹慧') as REPORT_DOCTOR_NAME,	--	报告医师签名

'' as IMAGE_DEVICE,	--	检验设备名称

'' as STATUS,	--	卡片状态
replace(replace(convert(varchar(19),a.Report_DT,120),'-',''),':','')  as EFFECTIVE_TIME,	--	活动发生时间

'370902' as DISTRICT_CODE,	--	所属行政区划
'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,	--	交换类型
'' as DEI,	--	数据交换标识符
'' as NODE_CODE,	--	节点标识符

(case a.pat_typecode when '1' then '1' when '3' then '2' when '4' then '3' else '' end) as SOURCE_CODE,	--	标本来源代码

'' as REVIEWERS_ID_NUM,	--	审核人员身份证号

'' as PRINT_PERSON,	--	报告单打印人
substring(a.req_reason,1,50) as LAB_PURPOSE,	--	检验目的
b.sampled_user as COLLECT_PERSON,	--	标本采样人
b.recieve_user as ACCEPT_PERSON	--	标本接收人
from lab_report a(nolock)
	inner join req_master b(nolock) on a.barcode = b.barcode
	inner join req_detail c(nolock) on c.barcode = b.barcode
	inner join lab_rptunit d(nolock) on a.rptunitid = d.rptunitid
where  a.rptunitid <>'50'
and a.barcode <> ''
and a.pat_sex <>''
and a.specimen_name <>''
and a.rechk_dt is NOT NULL 
and DATEDIFF(DAY,a.rechk_dt,GETDATE())=1
and exists(select 1 from lab_result m(nolock) where c.reportid = m.reportid and c.req_itemcode = m.req_itemcode)
and a.pat_name not like '%测试%'

'无' as ATTACHED_RESULT,--附属结果	VARCHAR2	100			附属结果
'无' as RESULT_EXPLAIN,--结果值的解释	VARCHAR2	32		是	
(case when a.rptunitid in ('14','43','19') then b.rpt_itemname else b.result_str end) as RESULT_EXPLAIN_NOTE	, --结果值的解释描述	VARCHAR2	200		是	必填

c.rpt_itemname as LOCAL_ITEM_NAME,--检验报告项目本地名称	VARCHAR2	80		是	检验报告项目医院内部名称
GETDATE() as SYSTEM_TIME,--数据上传时间戳	TIMESTAMP(6)	11		是	
'' as RESULT_CODE,--检验结果代码	CHAR	1			
'1' as RATION_RESULT,--检验定量结果	NUMBER	14,4			重复列，可以忽略
'1' as RATION_RESULT_UOM,--检验定量结果计量单位	VARCHAR2	20			重复列，可以忽略

'49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--医院组织机构代码	VARCHAR2	32		是	必填、
'山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--医院名称	VARCHAR2	70		是	必填
isnull(b.instrid,0) as test_exam_equip_code,--检查设备编码	VARCHAR2	32			
a.barcode as BARCODE_NO--标本条形码号	VARCHAR2	50

a.reportid as JYBGDH,--检验报告单号	VARCHAR(20)	必填	复合主键：按照一定的编码规则赋予检验报告的编号

(case when a.pat_typecode = '3' then (a.pat_no + a.inp_id) else  a.pat_no end)  as JZLSH,--就诊流水号	VARCHAR(50)	必填	患者某次就诊唯一索引号。详见1.3.3（依据患者来源区别门诊、住院）

isnull(cast(cast(a.pat_ageyear as int) as varchar),0) as NLN,--年龄（年）	NUMBER(3)	必填	患者的实足年龄，为患者出生后按照日历计算的历法年龄。年龄满1周岁的，以实足年龄的相应整数填写；
case when a.pat_ageyear<1 and a.pat_ageyear%1*12>1 then cast(a.pat_ageyear%1*12 as int) else '' end as NLY,--年龄（月）	NUMBER(2)	选填	年龄不足1周岁的，按照实足年龄的月龄填写

a.pat_no as GRBSH,
a.req_wardno as BQHM,
'' as BFH,
a.reportid,
a.req_reason as jyxmmc
from lab_report a(nolock)
	inner join lab_rptunit b(nolock) on a.rptunitid = b.rptunitid
	inner join req_master c(nolock) on a.barcode = c.barcode
where a.rechkflag = '9' and isnull(a.pat_no,'') <> '' and a.rptunitid not in ('55','54','21') 
      and a.barcode not like '4%' 
	  and a.sampledate >'2023-08-17'
	  and a.barcode  is not null

CREATE view [dbo].[YJ_JYBGMX] as
select 'YLV21051' as YLJGDM,--医疗机构代码	VARCHAR(22)	必填	复合主键：经《医疗机构执业许可证》登记的，并按照特定编码体系填写的代码
a.reportid+'_'+b.rpt_itemcode as JYBGMXLSH,--检验报告明细流水号	VARCHAR(20)	必填	复合主键：按照一定的编码规则赋予检验结果的编号
'山东省第二人民医院' as YLJGMC,--医疗机构名称	VARCHAR(70)	必填	就诊所在的医疗机构名称
a.reportid as JYBGDH,--检验报告单号	VARCHAR(20)	必填	按照一定的编码规则赋予检验报告的顺序号
a.barcode as JYSQDH,--检验申请单号	VARCHAR(20)	必填	检验申请的编号，与表YJ_JYBG中JYSQDH字段关联
c.testmethod as JYFF,--检验方法	VARCHAR(100)	选填	患者接受医学检查项目所采用的检验方法名称
b.result_ref as CKZ,--参考值	VARCHAR(200)	必填	针对每一个检验指标结果参考范围
(case when b.result_unit <'0' then '-'  when b.result_unit is null then '-' else b.result_unit end) as JYJLDW,--检验-计量单位	VARCHAR(20)	必填	患者定量检验测量值的计量单位
case when b.result_num is not null then '1' else '2' end  as JYJGLX,--检验结果类型	VARCHAR(1)	必填	1数值型，2阴阳，3字符型
cast(b.result_num as varchar) as JYJGSZ,--检验-结果(数值)	NUMBER(14,4)	选填	数值型检验结果值
case when b.result_num is null then convert(varchar(255),b.result_str) else '' end as JYJGDX,--检验-结果(定性)	VARCHAR(14)	选填	检验项目结果报告的客观说明
case when b.result_flag in ('H','L','P','Q') then '2' else '1' end as JYJGDM,--检验结果代码	VARCHAR(1)	选填	1正常，2异常， 3不确定
a.sampleno as JYYBH,--检验样本号	VARCHAR(20)	选填	按照某一特定编码规则赋予检验标本的顺序号
b.rpt_itemcode as JYXMDM,--检验-项目代码	VARCHAR(20)	必填	按照某一特定编码规则赋予系统中项目代码，具体以医院或省（盟）、市平台系统集成商为准，同时提交字典表
b.rpt_itemname as JYXMMC,--检验-项目名称	VARCHAR(80)	必填	按照某一特定编码规则赋予系统中项目名称，具体以医院或省（盟）、市平台系统集成商为准，同时提交字典表
convert(varchar,a.report_dt,120) as JYRQ,--检验日期	DATE	必填	检验项目执行当日的公元纪年日期的完整描述
'正常' as JYJGJL,--检验结果结论	VARCHAR(200)	必填	检验项目结果报告的客观说明
cast(d.seq as varchar) as JYXMSXH,--检验项目顺序号	VARCHAR(10)	必填	按照某一特定编码规则赋予该对象的顺序号
case when b.result_flag in ('H','L','P','Q') then '0' else '1' end  as JYJGYCBZ,--检验结果异常标志	VARCHAR(1)	必填	1正常，0异常
(case when cast(b.result_refh as varchar) is null then '' else cast(b.result_refh as varchar) end)   as CKSX,--正常值参考上限	NUMBER(10,2)	必填	检验指标结果正常范围的最大值
(case when cast(b.result_refl as varchar) is null then '' else cast(b.result_refl as varchar) end)   as CKXX,--正常值参考下限	NUMBER(10,2)	必填	检验指标结果正常范围的最小值
cast(b.result_refhh as varchar) as WJZSX,--危急值上限	NUMBER(10,2)	选填	检验指标结果危急值范围的最大值c
cast(b.result_refll as varchar) as WJZXX,--危急值下限	NUMBER(10,2)	选填	检验指标结果危急值范围的最小值
'1' as MJ,--密级	VARCHAR(2)	必填	见1.3.9密级字段规范
convert(varchar,a.rechk_dt,120) as TBRQ,--填报日期	DATE	必填	填报数据的时间。格式：YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss
convert(varchar,a.rechk_dt,120) as XGRQ,--修改日期	DATE	必填	数据最后操作时间。格式：YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss
'1' as XGBZ,--修改标志	VARCHAR(1)	必填	1新增，2删除
a.pat_no as GRBSH,
a.pat_no as JZLSH,
a.reportid
from lab_report a(nolock)
	inner join lab_result b(nolock) on a.reportid = b.reportid
	inner join lab_rptitem c(nolock) on b.rpt_itemcode = c.rpt_itemcode
	inner join lab_rptunit_item d(nolock) on a.rptunitid = d.rptunitid and b.rpt_itemcode = d.rpt_itemcode
 where a.rechkflag = '9' and isnull(a.pat_no,'') <> '' and a.rptunitid not in ('55','54','21') and a.barcode not like '4%' and a.barcode  >'1'  and a.sampledate >'2023-08-17'

--Name = "省二院检验报告细菌培养报告",
--Developer = "WZ", 
--DevDate = "2023/07/31",  
--Tester = "WZ", //接口测试工程师
--ReadMe = "省二院检验报告细菌培养报告", //接口说明
CREATE  view [dbo].[YJ_XJPYBG] as
select 'YLV21051' as YLJGDM,--医疗机构代码	VARCHAR(22)	必填	复合主键：经《医疗机构执业许可证》登记的，并按照特定编码体系填写的代码	
a.reportid+'_'+b.rpt_itemcode as XJJGID,--细菌结果ID	VARCHAR(50)	必填	复合主键：按照一定的编码规则赋予细菌培养报告的编号	
'山东省第二人民医院' as YLJGMC,--医疗机构名称	VARCHAR(70)	必填	就诊所在的医疗机构名称	
a.req_wardno as ZYBQ,--住院病区	VARCHAR(50)	选填	住院患者所在的病区代码	
a.req_bedno as ZYCH,--住院床号	VARCHAR(10)	选填	住院患者所在的病床编码	
a.barcode as SQDH,--申请单号	VARCHAR(20)	必填	关联《检验申请信息》	
a.reportid as JYBGDH,--检验报告单号	VARCHAR(20)	必填	按照某一特定编码规则赋予检验报告单的顺序号	
b.rpt_itemcode as XJDH,--细菌代号	VARCHAR(20)	必填	业务系统中给与细菌赋予的一定编号	
b.rpt_itemname as XJMC,--细菌名称	VARCHAR(50)	必填	业务系统中给与细菌赋予的一定名称。如：“金黄色葡萄球菌”等；如未发现细菌，填“无”	
b.result1 as JLJS,--菌落计数	VARCHAR(10)	选填	单位：CFU/ML；如“>10万”	
'' as PYJ,--培养基	VARCHAR(100)	必填	培养基的描述	
'' as PYKSSJ,--培养开始时间	DATE	选填	完成此项业务活动时的公元纪年日期和时间的完整描述YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss	
'' as PYJSSJ,--培养结束时间	DATE	选填	完成此项业务活动时的公元纪年日期和时间的完整描述格式：YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss（无时分秒以00:00:00替代）	
'' as PYTJ,--培养条件	VARCHAR(30)	选填	培养条件的描述	
case when b.result_str < '0' then '-' else b.result_str end as JYJG,--检验结果	VARCHAR(1000)	必填	具体描述培养情况	
'' as SBBM,--设备编码	VARCHAR(20)	选填	细菌培养的设备代号	
'' as YQBM,--仪器编码	VARCHAR(20)	选填	细菌培养的仪器代号	
'' as YQMC,--仪器名称	VARCHAR(30)	选填	细菌培养的仪器名称	
'1' as BGZTDM,--报告状态代码	VARCHAR(1)	必填	对报告状态的描述，在【检查检验报告状态代码表】值域范围内	
'完成' as BGZTMC,--报告状态名称	VARCHAR(8)	必填		
'/' as FXFS,--发现方式	VARCHAR(100)	必填	例如：“肉眼”或“镜检”等	
'' as MJ,--密级	VARCHAR(2)	必填	见1.3.9密级字段规范	
convert(varchar,a.rechk_dt,120) as TBRQ,--填报日期	DATE	必填	填报数据的时间。格式：YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss	
convert(varchar,a.rechk_dt,120) as XGRQ,--修改日期	DATE	必填	数据最后操作时间。格式：YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss	
'1' as XGBZ,--修改标志	VARCHAR(1)	必填	1新增，2删除	
a.pat_no as GRBSH,
(case when a.pat_typecode = '3' then (a.pat_no + a.inp_id) else  a.pat_no end)  as JZLSH,
a.reportid
from lab_report a(nolock)
	inner join lab_result b(nolock) on a.reportid = b.reportid
where a.rechkflag = '9' and a.germ_flag in ('1','2') and isnull(a.pat_no,'') <> ''  and a.sampledate >'2023-08-17'

--Name = "省二院检验报告药敏培养报告",
--Developer = "WZ", 
--DevDate = "2023/07/31",  
--Tester = "WZ", //接口测试工程师
--ReadMe = "省二院检验报告药敏培养报告", //接口说明
CREATE view [dbo].[YJ_YMPYBG] as
select 'YLV21051' as YLJGDM,--医疗机构代码	VARCHAR(22)	必填	复合主键：经《医疗机构执业许可证》登记的，并按照特定编码体系填写的代码
a.reportid+'_'+c.rpt_itemcode+'_'+c.medcode+'_'+c.medmethod as YMJGID,--药敏结果ID	VARCHAR(50)	必填	复合主键：按照一定的编码规则赋予药敏报告的编号
a.reportid+'_'+c.rpt_itemcode as XJJGID,--细菌结果ID	VARCHAR(50)	必填	关联细菌培养报告
'山东省第二人民医院' as YLJGMC,--医疗机构名称	VARCHAR(70)	必填	就诊所在的医疗机构名称
a.req_wardno as ZYBQ,--住院病区	VARCHAR(50)	选填	患者当前所在病区的名称
a.req_bedno as ZYCH,--住院床号	VARCHAR(10)	选填	住院患者所在的病床编码
a.barcode as SQDH,--申请单号	VARCHAR(20)	必填	关联《检验申请信息》
a.reportid as BGDH,--报告单号	VARCHAR(20)	必填	按照某一特定编码规则赋予报告单的顺序号
b.rpt_itemcode as XJDH,--细菌代号	VARCHAR(20)	必填	业务系统中给与细菌赋予的一定编号
b.rpt_itemname as XJMC,--细菌名称	VARCHAR(50)	必填	业务系统中给与细菌赋予的一定名称
c.medcode as YMDM,--药敏代码	VARCHAR(20)	必填	例如：阿莫西林的代码为“AMX”或“AMOX”
d.medname as YMMC,--药敏名称	VARCHAR(200)	必填	中文，例如：“阿莫西林”
c.result_flag as KYJGDM,--抗药结果代码	VARCHAR(1)	选填	按照某一特定编码规则赋予该对象的分类代码和名称
c.medresult as KYJGMC,--抗药结果名称	VARCHAR(4)	必填	
c.result6 as CKZ,--参考值	VARCHAR(20)	选填	针对每一个检验指标结果参考范围
'' as ZPHYL,--纸片含药量	VARCHAR(10)	选填	应包含单位：G、MG、µG
c.mic as YJND,--抑菌浓度	VARCHAR(10)	选填	即MIC；单位：G/ML
c.rad as YJHZJ,--抑菌环直径	VARCHAR(10)	选填	单位：MM
c.medmethod as JYFF,--检验方法	VARCHAR(100)	选填	患者接受医学检查项目所采用的检验方法名称
'' as MJ,--密级	VARCHAR(2)	必填	见1.3.9密级字段规范
convert(varchar,a.rechk_dt,120) as TBRQ,--填报日期	DATE	必填	填报数据的时间。格式：YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss
convert(varchar,a.rechk_dt,120) as XGRQ,--修改日期	DATE	必填	数据最后操作时间。格式：YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss
'1' as XGBZ,--修改标志	VARCHAR(1)	必填	1新增，2删除
a.pat_no as GRBSH,
a.pat_no as JZLSH,
a.reportid
from lab_report a(nolock)
	inner join lab_result b(nolock) on a.reportid = b.reportid
	inner join lab_resultmed c(nolock) on a.reportid = c.reportid and b.rpt_itemcode = c.rpt_itemcode
	inner join lab_med d(nolock) on c.medcode = d.medcode
where a.rechkflag = '9' and isnull(a.pat_no,'') <> ''  and a.sampledate >'2023-08-17'

columns.comment: 用户ID 登录或验证时使用,唯一
用户代码 可能是员工编码等,没有请设定和UserID相同
登录密码 来源于HIS系统内部定义，区分临床医生、护士、其他等
用户角色 如:医生,护士,医技人员等
有效状态 1=有效,0=无效,D=删除
电话号码 多用于接收危急值提醒短信
所属科室 可直接保存名称
备用1 可能有我们没有考虑到的又非常重要的信息,就保存在这里
备用2 可能有我们没有考虑到的又非常重要的信息,就保存在这里
备用3 保存如电子签名等加密的大数据
费别名称 如：自费、公费、医保等
组合类别 DP=科室，WD＝病区，PT＝病人类型，SP＝标本类型，DC＝医生，FT＝费别， RQ=申请项目
明细项目代码 根据combkind取值不同，对应的为科室代码，病区代码等等
科室类别 区分临床、医技等，使用系统代码表kind=DEPTTYPE
专业类别 针对临床科室才需要设置，对应系统代码kidno=DeptSubject
检验科执行科室 1=检验科执行科室，程序里选择执行科室时只显示这些科室
上级科室代码 一般统计使用
医生类别 来源于HIS系统内部定义，区分临床医生、护士、其他等
短信接收号码 多用于接收危急值提醒短信
员工代码 员工工号
登录代码 对应用户表的登录代码
所属检验科室 冗余，选择工作组时自动带出组所属科室
所属医院 冗余，选择工作组时自动带出组所属医院
RH血型 +,- 表示阴性、阳性
入科日期 开始工作日期
离职日期 离职日期
员工类别/用工性质 在岗，新轮岗，培训学员，进修人员，实习生等
婚否 0=未婚，1=已婚，2=离异，3=丧偶
医院代码 内部编码唯一
医院机构代码 区域时应当设定为机构代码
外部代码 区域医疗时可能用到作为条码前缀或后缀
所属区域 每个区域一般有一个收费标准，是扣率的计算基准
默认扣率 针对独立检验中心的送检医院的扣率
联系人 医院联系人
所属销售 针对独立检验中心
医院属性 1=检验医院,2=送检单位,3=既是送检医院也是检验医院（区域医疗中）
报告单标题 为空则使用当前检验系统标题
需要报告数据类型 0=不需要数据， 1=仅报告数据， 2=仅PDF报告， 3=数据+PDF
物流人员 现场收集标本人员（检验中心）
医院级别 来自字典kindno=hospclass
账期日 1-31，计算下次结账日期时要向这个字段靠拢
结账间隔周期 D=天，M=月
客户类型 医院、代理商、个人
先付款标记 1=必须先付款才能看报告
是否付款客户 0-否 1 是
血库执行组 某些院区没有血库时就设定为送往的目标血库组
病人号 就诊号门诊为门诊号住院为住院号（习惯号码）
可编辑 只是tabseq=0，但可以双击
禁止编辑 双击也不可以编辑
对应科室代码 对应科室字典表代码
业务类型 LIS=检验,BLD=血库，BAC＝微生物
配血标本号前缀 配血时，区分不同组的标本号前缀，建议用大写字母A、B、C等；微生物时作为检验标本号前缀
标本库位编码前缀 多个用|隔开
默认销售 区域默认的销售员工代码DC_Employee中的employno
预制条码起始字符 标码标识
标签打印份数 打印份数，同一个条码
试管颜色 条码颜色
标本采样说明 采样说明
附加费用规则 附加收费策略，如采血费，试管费的收取规则
无菌标本 1=表示无菌标本
危急值时效 0总是上报，－1表示本次就诊只上报一次（必须配置就诊号inp_id字段），>0时，在此小时数内上报过则不再上报
签收修改 签收时需要确认标本类型是否正确，会开窗选择
收费项目名称 项目中文
HIS对应项目代码 HIS项目代码
HIS项目类别 HIS中的项目类别（如果有的话）
执行科室 HIS系统里的执行科室
同步备注信息 由每天自动同步时写入
卡长度 表示不校验长度
开始字符 为空表示不校验
结束字符 为空表示不校验
截取长度 负数表示右边剔除多少位，0表示从开始位一直到最后
计价科室 1=执行科室，2＝开单科室，3＝病人病区
数量 =0表示按照次数计价，一次采血仅记录一次
HIS记录ID 记录HIS中某条记录主键（联合主键自行组合），多种表使用前缀区分，申请单明细项目记录ID前面自动增加病人类型前缀(如：ID为32456则门诊记录到本表为1_32456，住院为3_32456)
方法代码 当前接口为“外部后台服务”时为：Plan_Event
执行方式 1=实时执行，2=后台执行，3=实时失败转后台
备注 可以编写修订记录
取值类型 DEPT=科室,WARD=病区,PATTYPE=病人类型,DOCTOR=医生,USER=用户,FEETYPE=收费类型,USER1=Hiscode1,USER2=Hiscode2等，以后补充
模块代码 BLD=血库，LAB=检验，等等
病人类型 1＝门诊，2＝急诊，3＝住院，4＝体检等，体检时也可直接保存名称
病人号 就诊号门诊为门诊号住院为住院号（习惯号码）
住院标识 用于区分同一住院号多次住院，门诊用于保存就诊序号
